approval_decision_consistent.name: approval_decision_consistent
approval_decision_consistent.value: ("approval"."status" = 'pending' AND "approval"."decided_by_type" IS NULL AND "approval"."decided_by_id" IS NULL AND "approval"."decided_at" IS NULL AND "approval"."evidence_ref" IS NULL) OR ("approval"."status" IN ('approved', 'rejected') AND "approval"."decided_by_type" = 'human' AND length(btrim("approval"."decided_by_id")) > 0 AND "approval"."decided_at" IS NOT NULL AND length(btrim("approval"."evidence_ref")) > 0)

invitation_acceptance_consistent.name: invitation_acceptance_consistent
invitation_acceptance_consistent.value: ("invitation"."status" = 'accepted' AND "invitation"."accepted_by" IS NOT NULL AND "invitation"."accepted_at" IS NOT NULL) OR ("invitation"."status" <> 'accepted' AND "invitation"."accepted_by" IS NULL AND "invitation"."accepted_at" IS NULL)

social_channel_control_pause_consistent.name: social_channel_control_pause_consistent
social_channel_control_pause_consistent.value: ("social_channel_control"."circuit_status" = 'active' AND "social_channel_control"."pause_reason" IS NULL) OR ("social_channel_control"."circuit_status" = 'paused' AND "social_channel_control"."pause_reason" IS NOT NULL)

video_job_lease_consistent.name: video_job_lease_consistent
video_job_lease_consistent.value: ("video_job"."status" = 'running' AND "video_job"."claimed_by" IS NOT NULL AND "video_job"."claimed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "video_job"."lease_expires_at" IS NOT NULL) OR ("video_job"."status" <> 'running' AND "video_job"."claimed_by" IS NULL AND "video_job"."claimed_at" IS NULL AND "video_job"."lease_expires_at" IS NULL)

video_model_config_enabled_verified.name: video_model_config_enabled_verified
video_model_config_enabled_verified.value: NOT "video_model_config"."enabled" OR ("video_model_config"."verified_at" IS NOT NULL AND "video_model_config"."verification_ref" IS NOT NULL AND length(btrim("video_model_config"."verification_ref")) > 0)

video_upload_receipt_size_positive.name: video_upload_receipt_size_positive
video_upload_receipt_size_positive.value: "video_upload_receipt"."size_bytes" > 0 AND (("video_upload_receipt"."content_type" LIKE 'image/%' AND "video_upload_receipt"."size_bytes" <= 20971520) OR ("video_upload_receipt"."content_type" IN ('video/mp4', 'video/quicktime') AND "video_upload_receipt"."size_bytes" < 1073741824))

video_upload_receipt_claim_consistent.name: video_upload_receipt_claim_consistent
video_upload_receipt_claim_consistent.value: ("video_upload_receipt"."status" = 'claimed' AND "video_upload_receipt"."evidence_id" IS NOT NULL AND "video_upload_receipt"."claimed_at" IS NOT NULL) OR "video_upload_receipt"."status" <> 'claimed'

workflow_gate_reference_consistent.name: workflow_gate_reference_consistent
workflow_gate_reference_consistent.value: ("workflow_event"."gate" IS NULL AND "workflow_event"."approval_id" IS NULL) OR ("workflow_event"."gate" IS NOT NULL AND "workflow_event"."approval_id" IS NOT NULL)
